name: Gen X Soft Club
summary: Gen X Soft Club was particularly popular in the United Kingdom at this time, succeeding the initial Britpop / Cool Britannia wave of the mid-1990s.
description: Gen X Soft Club was particularly popular in the United Kingdom at this time, succeeding the initial Britpop / Cool Britannia wave of the mid-1990s. Artists in the Electronica (Fatboy Slim, The Chemical Brothers, Stereolab, Massive Attack) and Post-Britpop (Radiohead, Travis, Starsailor, Doves) genres were seen as representing Y2K/GXSC in both sound and album covers.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): A more natural, softer look into 90s/2000s futurism, with an urban twist.

visualDNA.colour: Natural and muted colors such as greens, blues, beiges, tans and greys/black

fashion.Overview: Following trends with the rest of the visual identity of the aesthetic, GXSC's fashion is inspired by Y2K Futurism 's fashion but with a much more muted, softer appearance. Some fashion trends include nude lipstick, middle parts or natural textured hair, natural leathers, knee-high boots, duster jackets, and other alternative streetwear styles.
